title: Luteolin inhibits inflammation and M1 macrophage polarization in the treatment of Pseudomonas aeruginosa-induced acute pneumonia through suppressing EGFR/PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB and EGFR/ERK/AP-1 signaling pathways.
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究木犀草素通过EGFR/PI3K/AKT/NF-kB和EGFR/ERK/AP-1通路抑制铜绿假单胞菌肺炎炎症和M1巨噬细胞极化，核心是药物抗炎机制，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The opportunistic pathogen Pseudomonas aeruginosa primarily causes infections in immunocompromised individuals. Luteolin, a natural flavonoid, is widely present in plants, which exerts various pharmacological activities, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. PURPOSE: This study aimed to explore the therapeutic efficacy of luteolin and the underlying molecular mechanisms in treating the P. aeruginosa-induced acute pneumonia. METHODS: Network pharmacology was utilized to identify the core targets of luteolin for treating acute P. aeruginosa pneumonia. Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analysis were performed to dissect the potential effects of luteolin and the involved signaling pathways. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay and molecular docking were employed for studying the binding affinities of luteolin with the key targets. Furthermore, we applied a mouse model of bacterial pneumonia for assessing the therapeutic effects of luteolin in vivo, and an in vitro infection model for specifically investigating the effects of luteolin on macrophages as well as the underlying mechanisms upon P. aeruginosa infection. RESULTS: Network pharmacology identified TNF, IL-6, EGFR and AKT1 as the key targets of luteolin for treating acute P. aeruginosa pneumonia. Moreover, as revealed by GO and KEGG enrichment analysis, EGFR, MAPK and PI3K/AKT pathways were the potential pathways regulated the P. aeruginosa-induced inflammatory response. According to the in vivo results, luteolin effectively mitigated the P. aeruginosa-induced acute lung injury through reducing the pulmonary permeability, neutrophil infiltration, proinflammatory cytokine production (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF and MIP-2) and bacterial burden in lung tissues, which led to increased survival rate of mice. Furthermore, the luteolin-treated mice had diminished EGFR, PI3K, AKT, IkappaBalpha, NF-kappaB p65, ERK, c-Jun and c-Fos phosphorylation, down-regulated M1 macrophage marker levels (iNOS, CD86 and IL-1beta) but up-regulated M2 macrophage marker levels (Ym1, CD206 and Arg1) in lung tissues. Consistently, the luteolin-pretreated macrophages exhibited reduced phosphorylation of these regulatory proteins, diminished proinflammatory cytokine production, and down-regulated expression of M1 macrophage markers, but up-regulated expression of IL-10 and M2 macrophage markers. CONCLUSION: luteolin effectively suppressed the inflammatory responses and M1 macrophage polarization through inhibiting EGFR/PI3K/AKT/NF-kappaB and EGFR/ERK/AP-1 signaling pathways in the treatment of acute P. aeruginosa pneumonia. This study suggests that luteolin could be a promising candidate for development as a therapeutic agent for acute bacterial pneumonia.
abstract_zh: 背景：机会性病原体铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）主要感染免疫功能低下的个体。木犀草素（Luteolin）是一种天然类黄酮，广泛存在于植物中，具有多种药理活性，包括抗炎和抗菌活性。目的：本研究旨在探讨木犀草素治疗铜绿假单胞菌诱导的急性肺炎的疗效及其潜在分子机制。方法：利用网络药理学（network pharmacology）鉴定木犀草素治疗急性铜绿假单胞菌肺炎的核心靶点。进行基因本体论（Gene Ontology, GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, KEGG）富集分析，以解析木犀草素的潜在效应及涉及的信号通路。采用表面等离子体共振（surface plasmon resonance, SPR）实验和分子对接（molecular docking）研究木犀草素与关键靶点的结合亲和力。此外，我们应用细菌性肺炎小鼠模型评估木犀草素在体内的治疗效果，并利用体外感染模型专门研究木犀草素对巨噬细胞的影响及铜绿假单胞菌感染后的潜在机制。结果：网络药理学鉴定出TNF、IL-6、EGFR和AKT1为木犀草素治疗急性铜绿假单胞菌肺炎的关键靶点。此外，GO和KEGG富集分析显示，EGFR、MAPK和PI3K/AKT通路是调控铜绿假单胞菌诱导炎症反应的潜在通路。根据体内结果，木犀草素通过降低肺通透性、中性粒细胞浸润、促炎细胞因子产生（IL-1β、IL-6、TNF和MIP-2）及肺组织中的细菌载量，有效减轻了铜绿假单胞菌诱导的急性肺损伤，从而提高了小鼠的存活率。此外，木犀草素处理的小鼠肺组织中EGFR、PI3K、AKT、IκBα、NF-κB p65、ERK、c-Jun和c-Fos磷酸化水平降低，M1巨噬细胞标志物水平（iNOS、CD86和IL-1β）下调，而M2巨噬细胞标志物水平（Ym1、CD206和Arg1）上调。一致地，木犀草素预处理的巨噬细胞表现出这些调控蛋白磷酸化减少、促炎细胞因子产生减少、M1巨噬细胞标志物表达下调，但IL-10和M2巨噬细胞标志物表达上调。结论：木犀草素通过抑制EGFR/PI3K/AKT/NF-κB和EGFR/ERK/AP-1信号通路，有效抑制了急性铜绿假单胞菌肺炎中的炎症反应和M1巨噬细胞极化。本研究提示，木犀草素可能成为开发急性细菌性肺炎治疗药物的有前景的候选化合物。
